name.value: Right Choice Camp & Catering - Pink Mountain Lodge

description.value: Pink Mountain Lodge is an industrial work camp operated under the Right Choice Camp & Catering brand, now part of Dexterra Group's remote workforce hospitality division. Located at the northern end of the Alaska Highway corridor, it provides reservations-only lodging targeted at crews working remote resource extraction and construction projects. Touring cyclists passing through one of BC's most isolated stretches may find it a rare roofed option, but access appears to be oriented toward contracted workforce clients rather than the general public.

The website's open lodge description does confirm laundry and Wi-Fi as standard amenities at their lodges, and OSM confirms internet_access=yes, but no bike-specific information exists anywhere.
